checkpoint_policy: fixed epoch 80; no validation-selected checkpoint; no early stopping
interpretation: extreme source-only two-class spatial-transfer stress test; not nine-class generalization and not external-site validation
purpose: Reviewer-requested target-blind spectral validation of Spectrum-RDFT and SCAL-RDFT on the frozen F4_to_F1 B3 target.

rdft.centering: mean subtraction over retained frequency bins per spatial channel

source_validation_policy: source_val is excluded from checkpoint/model selection because actual 8192x128 raw supports overlap source_train; it is retained only as provenance/audit metadata.
test_access_policy: target_test loader/evaluation is created only after epoch 80 training completes; target metrics are never used for tuning or selection.
uncertainty: 2000 class-stratified event bootstrap replicates per seed; across-seed mean±SD reported descriptively
